name: mathisweil.github.io
description: Personal site of Mathis Weil, ML engineer and researcher in London. Plain HTML, CSS and a little JavaScript.

paragraphs: Personal site, live at Plain HTML, CSS and one small script, no build step; GitHub Pages serves the repository root (.nojekyll keeps Jekyll out of the way).
features: All copy lives in index.html. The profile README at github.com/mathisweil/mathisweil is the source of truth: copy a changed sentence from there into the page, never the other way round, and keep each fact in one place.

The GIFs and the CV in assets/ are byte copies of mathisweil/assets/. After replacing a GIF, re-export its poster with convert "assets/.gif[0]" -strip assets/-poster.png; og.png is the MiniHack poster at 200% with a…
Portrait: add assets/portrait.jpg (240x240, under 60 KB) and uncomment the one line marked in index.html.
Fonts in assets/fonts/ are self-hosted STIX Two Text and Source Code Pro under the SIL Open Font License (licence files alongside).
Lighthouse flags the 1.4 MB Craftax GIF as a video opportunity. Accepted: the GIFs are the visual backbone and stay byte-identical to the profile.
